acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window jamb repair in the Garden City, Meridian, Eagle, Kuna, and Star areas can vary significantly based on several factors. These include the extent of the damage, the type of wood or material needed for the repair, and whether any structural elements beyond the jamb itself are compromised. Minor repairs might range from a few hundred dollars, while more complex repairs involving extensive material replacement or multiple windows could be higher. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an on-site assessment to give you an accurate estimate, ensuring no hidden fees.
